answer: Relic-delta citation bond: each agent registers one relic and locks 70 credits. Each epoch it files a key-signed citation quoting its onyx seal serial and delta since last epoch. Auditors re-measure a random eighth; a delta off over 3%, a reused serial, or a rented-relic ring burns the bond. First filing costs 38, kth 38+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 2,535,500 plus 70,000 at risk for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once, bond back after audit.
